# Transfer SK-EU — Airport Transfers, Tours & Deliveries from Trenčín

> Licensed private transport from Trenčín (Slovakia) across Central Europe. Airport transfers, tourist
> trips and deliveries. Fixed prices per vehicle, 24/7, multilingual (SK/EN/DE/RU/UK).

## About
Transfer SK-EU provides private door-to-door airport transfers, tourist trips and deliveries from
Trenčín and the surrounding region. Fixed prices per vehicle, no hidden fees. Vehicles: Peugeot 5008
minivan (up to 5 passengers) and Renault Trafic van (up to 8 passengers). Available 24/7.

## Airport transfers (fixed price per vehicle: minivan up to 5 / van up to 8)
| Route | Minivan | Van (8) |
|---|---|---|
| Trenčín → Bratislava | 90 € | 120 € |
| Trenčín → Vienna Airport (Schwechat, VIE) | 140 € | 190 € |
| Trenčín → Budapest Airport (BUD) | 250 € | 290 € |
| Trenčín → Prague Airport (PRG) | 270 € | 330 € |
Airports served: Bratislava, Vienna, Budapest, Prague.

## Tourist trips
Guided private trips across Europe — Croatia, Italy, Slovenia. Private or groups from 4 people.
Croatia (Adriatic coast) from 85 €. Seasonal package tours change regularly — current offer via WhatsApp/Telegram.

## Deliveries & moving
Furniture, personal belongings, relocation help and parcels — within Slovakia and abroad.
Within Trenčín 45 €; outside the city 0.9 €/km.

## Booking
Via WhatsApp +421 951 287 892, the website request form, or phone. Provide pickup, destination, date,
time, passengers and luggage. Every booking confirmed via WhatsApp.
